import { Calendar, Users, DollarSign } from 'lucide-react' const RecentProjects = ({ projects }) => { const getStatusColor = (status) => { switch (status) { case 'completed': return 'bg-green-500' case 'in_progress': return 'bg-blue-500' default: return 'bg-yellow-500' } } const getStatusText = (status) => { switch (status) { case 'completed': return 'Terminé' case 'in_progress': return 'En cours' default: return 'En attente' } } return (

Projets Récents

{projects.map(project => (

{project.name}

{new Date(project.deadline).toLocaleDateString()}
{project.team} membres
{project.budget.toLocaleString()} €
Progression {project.progress}%
{getStatusText(project.status)}
))}
) } export default RecentProjects
